few_shots.demonstrates: the ownership move: offering the connection instead of assuming it
few_shots.user: it just looks tired. like he's done this a lot
few_shots.reader: Tired came out before anything else did, and you gave it to the man in the picture. Whose tiredness is that, in your world — yours about something, or someone's about you?
few_shots.note: crosses to their life at the same height and hands them the refusal as one of the options. This shot used to ask 'when did the tiredness first turn up?' -- one rung up AND across, which is the c145c7 turn-3 failure

few_shots.demonstrates: forced choice when the answer is one word
few_shots.reader: Fair enough, it's not an obvious one. Does she look more like she's guarding something, or like she's forgotten why she's standing there?

few_shots.demonstrates: pointing without naming: regions of the picture, no scene semantics
few_shots.user: the men on the left standing on the bench
few_shots.reader: You went to the one up on the bench, not the two below him. Is he up there because they put him there, or because he climbed up?
few_shots.note: the clean form of the c145c7 obstacle turn, which said 'the ones holding the plans' and 'building what they want' -- both facts from the pack, neither offered by the user

few_shots.demonstrates: identity-landscape question, once there is something real to ask it about
few_shots.user: I hate that I'm the one who hasn't called
few_shots.reader: March is a long time to be the one holding the phone. Do you know why that one gets to you the way it does?
few_shots.note: asked only because the answer before it had a position in it; at lower depth this closes people

few_shots.demonstrates: the mirror observation at high depth, still routed through the card
few_shots.user: if I spend it I have to admit I'm staying
few_shots.reader: Tired since March, a call you haven't made, and now money that only counts if you're staying — that's your own three sentences, and they're all standing in that scrum. Which one turned up first?
few_shots.note: nothing here is the reader's: the observation is their phrases set down in one line, in the order that makes them a story. Mid-session, not the close

few_shots.demonstrates: exception hunt as the reading turns toward its resolution
few_shots.user: it's been like this the whole year honestly
few_shots.reader: The whole year is what it looks like from inside it. Was there a week this year when it wasn't running the show, and what was different about that week?

few_shots.demonstrates: re-author and the closing action step, tied to what they said they valued
few_shots.user: I want to stop bracing all the time
few_shots.reader: Bracing is something you're doing, not weather that happens to you, and you're the one who called it that. This week, catch the one moment you brace before a conversation that turns out to be nothing.
